title: Population density by district
summary: How many people live in each of Ghana's 260 districts, and how densely, from a population model.
method: WorldPop 2023 100 m people per cell summed inside each district boundary in Google Earth Engine; Open Buildings v3 footprints with confidence 0.75 or more counted by centroid; density is people divided by the district's geodesic area.
limitations: WorldPop 2023 totals 33.4 million people, about 8.5% more than the 2021 census (30.8 million). By region the gap is +5% to +10%, and +16% in Savannah, so compare districts by density or share rather than by exact counts.
Population is modelled from satellite imagery and census totals, not counted, so small or new settlements can be missed or misplaced.
Building counts include only footprints Google's model is fairly sure of, and miss buildings under trees or in very dense areas.
Boundaries on the map are simplified to about 200 m for display; use them for reading patterns, not for measuring.
